scripts.dev:backend: ENV_FILE=.env.dev uv run --project backend fastapi dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 bun run dev --host localhost --port 5173 --strictPort
scripts.db:bootstrap:dev: uv run --project backend python scripts/bootstrap-local.py --env dev
scripts.db:bootstrap:stage: uv run --project backend python scripts/bootstrap-local.py --env stage
scripts.db:reset:dev: uv run --project backend python scripts/reset-local.py --env dev
scripts.db:reset:stage: uv run --project backend python scripts/reset-local.py --env stage
